versions.

members.name: sourceUrl
members.documentation: The address a citation of this document links to.

members.name: externalId
members.documentation: The caller's own key for the document, unique within the knowledge base.

members.name: metadata
members.documentation:
Values for the metadata fields the knowledge base defines, including `title`, `summary`,
`keywords`, `author` and `publishedDate`.

members.name: extraMetadata
members.documentation:
Keys the knowledge base does not define. Stored and returned, but never searched on or given to
an agent.

members.name: readers
members.documentation: Who may read the document.

members.name: inheritedFrom
members.documentation: When `readers` is `inherit`: the folder whose readers apply.

members.name: outOfDate
members.documentation:
True when a newer way of processing documents is available, and processing the document again
would use it.

members.name: pageCount
members.documentation: The number of pages, for a paged document.

members.name: durationSeconds
members.documentation: How long it plays, in seconds, for audio and video.

members.name: processing
members.documentation:
The work running on the document, while there is some: what kind, which stage, how far it has
got and how long is left. Absent when nothing is running.

members.name: createdAt
members.documentation: When the document was created.

members.name: updatedAt
members.documentation: When the document or its bytes last changed.

members.name: partialFailures
members.documentation:
Enrichments that did not complete (a picture description, metadata extraction, a table).
They never fail the document. At most the first 100.

members.name: failure
members.documentation:
Why the document could not be made searchable. Present only when `status` is `failed`; a
document that is searchable with gaps lists them in `partialFailures` instead.

members.name: etag
members.documentation: The document's ETag; send it as `If-Match` to change it.

members.name: document
members.documentation: The document as it now is.

DocumentCounts.documentation: How many of a knowledge base's documents need attention.

members.name: processing
members.documentation: Documents being processed.

members.name: failed
members.documentation: Documents whose latest attempt failed.

members.name: outOfDate
members.documentation: Documents processed in an older way than the newest, which `ReprocessDocuments` would update.

DocumentDeleteResult.documentation: The result of deleting one document in a batch.

members.name: documentId
members.documentation: The document the result is for.

members.name: status
members.documentation: Whether the delete was accepted.

members.name: code
members.documentation:
Why it failed, as a stable code, for example `NOT_FOUND` or `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`. Present only when
`failed`.

members.name: detail
members.documentation: What went wrong, written for the integrator. Present only when `failed`.

members.name: documentId
members.documentation: The document that was deleted.

DocumentFailure.documentation: Why a document failed, as a stable code and a message telling the caller what to do.

members.name: code
members.documentation: What went wrong.

members.name: message
members.documentation:
What went wrong and what to do, written for the integrator. The same for every document
with the same code.

DocumentMatch.documentation: An existing document a planned item refers to.

members.name: documentId
members.documentation: The existing document the item would act on.

members.name: path
members.documentation: Where that document is now, which may differ from the item's path.

members.name: version
members.documentation: The document's current version number.

members.name: sha256
members.documentation: The base64-encoded SHA-256 of the document's current bytes.

members.name: restoresVersion
members.documentation: For `changed`: the earlier version whose bytes the item's equal.

DocumentProcessing.documentation: The work running on one document.

members.name: kind
members.documentation: What the work running on the document is doing.

members.name: stage
members.documentation: The stage the work is at, for display. Open: stages are added as ingestion changes.

members.name: percent
members.documentation:
How far the work has got, from 0 to 100, as the server weights it by how long each stage takes:
never moving back, and 100 only once the document can be searched. Clients show this figure,
easing between reports, and never compute their own.

members.name: eta
members.documentation: How long is left, once the work has run long enough to say.

members.name: estimate
members.documentation:
What the work was expected to take and cost: first from the file, then refined from what
ingestion measured.

members.name: startedAt
members.documentation: When the work started.

members.name: updatedAt
members.documentation: When the progress last changed.

members.name: documentId
members.documentation: The document whose processing moved on.

members.name: processing
members.documentation: How far the document's processing has got.

DocumentVersion.documentation: One version of a document's bytes.

members.name: number
members.documentation: The version's number: `1` is the first.

members.name: documentId
members.documentation: The document the version belongs to.

members.name: status
members.documentation: Where the version is in its lifecycle.

members.name: stage
members.documentation: While `processing`, what the server is doing, for display only.

members.name: contentType
members.documentation: The media type of the version's bytes.

members.name: byteSize
members.documentation: The size of the version's bytes, in bytes.

members.name: sha256
members.documentation: The base64-encoded SHA-256 of the version's bytes.

members.name: current
members.documentation: True when this is the version search uses.

members.name: latest
members.documentation: True when this is the newest version.

members.name: note
members.documentation: The note written when the version was added.

members.name: failure
members.documentation: Why the version failed. Present only when `status` is `failed`.

members.name: createdAt
members.documentation: When the version was added.

members.name: documentId
members.documentation: The document whose new version became searchable.

members.name: version
members.documentation: The version that became searchable, now the current one.

members.name: seconds
members.documentation: Seconds left, as a range.

members.name: type
members.documentation: The kind of caller.

members.name: userId
members.documentation: The person, shown only to the owner of the event's subject.

members.name: apiClientId
members.documentation: The API client, shown only to the owner of the event's subject.

members.name: type
members.documentation: The kind of thing. Open: `conversation` today.

members.name: id
members.documentation: The identifier of the thing the event is about, of the kind `type` names.

Field.documentation: A metadata field: a value each document in the knowledge base can carry.

members.name: name
members.documentation: The field's name, as people see it.

members.name: description
members.documentation: What the field holds, for people.

members.name: type
members.documentation: How the field's values are entered and checked; a list field offers its `choices`.

members.name: scope
members.documentation:
Where the field's values belong. Defaults to `document`. A value that belongs to each
passage cannot be set on a document.

members.name: choices
members.documentation: For `list`: the values it may take.

members.name: partialDates
members.documentation:
For a `date` field: what is stored when a document gives only a month or a year. Defaults to
`start`.

members.name: instructions
members.documentation: How ingestion fills the field, and how an agent uses it.

members.name: filterable
members.documentation: Whether searches can filter on the field. Defaults to false.

members.name: givenToAgent
members.documentation: Whether the field's value is given to the agent with each passage. Defaults to false.

members.name: visibleOnDocuments
members.documentation: Whether the field is shown in a document's settings. Defaults to true.

members.name: key
members.documentation: The field's key, as documents' `metadata` names it.

members.name: needsWork
members.documentation:
How many documents still need work for this field: values to fill in, index writes and new
search vectors.

members.name: etag
members.documentation: The field's ETag; send it as `If-Match` to change it.

FieldError.documentation: One problem with one request member or query parameter.

members.name: pointer
members.documentation:
A JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) into the request body, for example `/context/0/label`. Absent when
the problem is with a query parameter.

members.name: parameter
members.documentation:
The query parameter at fault, for example `filter[staus][eq]`. Absent when the problem is in
the body.

members.name: code
members.documentation: The code for this field's problem, from the same catalogue as the response's own code.

members.name: detail
members.documentation: What is wrong with the field, written for the integrator.

FieldInstructions.documentation: How a metadata field is filled and used.

members.name: howToFill
members.documentation: How ingestion works out the field's value from a document.

members.name: whenToUse
members.documentation: How an agent should use the value when it reads it.

FieldSource.documentation: One place a phase field's value may come from.

members.name: kind
members.documentation:
Which place the value comes from. The other members name the tool, the fixed values or the
earlier phase.

members.name: toolName
members.documentation: For `tool_result`: the tool whose result holds the value.

members.name: path
members.documentation:
For `tool_result`: a path into the tool's output, for example `results[0].id`. Empty means the
whole output.

members.name: values
members.documentation: For `allowed_values`: the values the field may take, at least one.

members.name: phase
members.documentation: For `earlier_phase`: the phase that gathered the value.

members.name: field
members.documentation: For `earlier_phase`: the field it was gathered as.

FieldWork.documentation: How many documents still need work for one field.

members.name: values
members.documentation: Documents with no value yet, which a fill-in would fill.

members.name: index
members.documentation: Documents whose value is not yet written to the search index.

members.name: embed
members.documentation: Documents whose passages need new search vectors for the field.

members.name: documents
members.documentation: Documents needing any of these.

Folder.documentation: A folder in a knowledge base.

members.name: path
members.documentation: The folder's path, for example `/hr/leave/`.

members.name: parent
members.documentation: The folder it is in.

members.name: name
members.documentation: The folder's own name, the last part of its path.

members.name: etag
members.documentation: The folder's ETag; send it as `If-Match` to rename or move it.

members.name: readers
members.documentation: Who may read the folder's documents.

members.name: inheritedFrom
members.documentation: When `readers` is `inherit`: the folder whose readers apply.

members.name: folderCount
members.documentation: How many folders are directly in it.

members.name: documentCount
members.documentation: How many documents are directly in it.

members.name: updatedAt
members.documentation: When the folder last changed.

members.name: folder
members.documentation: The folder as it now is.

members.name: path
members.documentation: Where the deleted folder was.

GuardrailSummary.documentation: A guardrail an agent version can screen attached documents with.

members.name: id
members.documentation: The guardrail's identifier, as `contentSafety.guardrail` names it.

members.name: name
members.documentation: The guardrail's name, as people see it.

members.name: version
members.documentation: The guardrail version that screens documents.

HistoryEntry.documentation: A live history entry. A list leaves `configuration` out; read one entry to get it.

members.name: id
members.documentation: The identifier GetHistoryEntry takes to read this entry with its configuration.

members.name: agentId
members.documentation: The agent whose live version changed.

members.name: version
members.documentation: The version live pointed at after the change.

members.name: previousVersion
members.documentation: The version live pointed at before the change. Absent for an agent's first publish.

members.name: kind
members.documentation: What kind of change it was.

members.name: changedAt
members.documentation: When live changed.

members.name: changedBy
members.documentation: Who changed it.

members.name: note
members.documentation: The note written with the change.

members.name: changedMembers
members.documentation:
The members that differ between `previousVersion` and `version`, computed when the entry was
written. Lists are compared by their items' keys.

members.name: configuration
members.documentation:
The configuration of `version`. Present only when the caller may read that version, as
GetAgentVersion checks: the permission to read versions, and the agent grant and the agent's
version access grant. Absent otherwise, in a list, and when that
version no longer exists.

HoldingPhrases.documentation: What a live avatar says while an answer is being written.

members.name: openers
members.documentation: Phrases that acknowledge the person has finished speaking.

members.name: groups
members.documentation: Groups of phrases, said one group after another while the answer is written.

members.name: stillProcessing
members.documentation: What the avatar says when the answer is taking longer than usual.

members.name: followUp
members.documentation: What the avatar says to invite the person to clarify when no answer arrived.

members.name: intervalMs
members.documentation: Milliseconds between holding phrases, from 1,000 to 60,000.

members.name: skipChance
members.documentation:
The chance, from 0 to 1, that any one holding phrase is skipped, so the rhythm sounds less
mechanical.

IngestionBatch.documentation: An ingestion batch: a planned set of document changes to a knowledge base, and their progress.

members.name: id
members.documentation: The identifier every call about this batch takes.

members.name: knowledgeBaseId
members.documentation: The knowledge base the batch ingests into.

members.name: status
members.documentation: Where the batch is in its lifecycle.

members.name: start
members.documentation: When the batch starts once it is planned.

members.name: awaitMoreItems
members.documentation: While true, the batch stays `draft` and takes more items.

members.name: policy
members.documentation: The rules that resolve each item's outcome.

members.name: scope
members.documentation: When set, every item must lie inside this folder.

members.name: itemCount
members.documentation: How many items the batch holds.

members.name: counts
members.documentation: Items by outcome after planning, and by status after Start.

members.name: percent
members.documentation:
How far the batch has got, from 0 to 100: its documents' progress, weighted by how long each
is expected to take. Never moves back.

members.name: eta
members.documentation: How long is left: the longest of its documents' times left.

members.name: planExpiresAt
members.documentation:
When the plan goes stale, 5 minutes after planning. A stale plan does not end the batch:
StartIngestionBatch on a stale plan plans again first.

members.name: uploadsExpireAt
members.documentation:
When uploads must arrive by: the upload policy's `expiresAt` plus a grace of 5 minutes, or of
`uploadWindowSeconds` when that is shorter. An item whose bytes
have not arrived by then fails with `UPLOAD_EXPIRED`; bytes that arrived in time are accepted
when they are reported, however late. A caller watching the batch can read it again after this
time to see which items failed. Renewing the upload policy moves it later. Absent when no item
is awaiting upload.

members.name: createdBy
members.documentation: Who made the batch.

members.name: createdAt
members.documentation: When the batch was made.

members.name: updatedAt
members.documentation: When the batch last changed.

members.name: startedAt
members.documentation: When the batch was started.

members.name: endedAt
members.documentation: When the batch reached a final state.

members.name: failure
members.documentation:
Why the batch failed, as a stable code and a fixed message. Present only when `status` is
`failed`.

members.name: uploadWindowSeconds
members.documentation:
How long each upload policy the batch hands out lasts, renewals included, as set when the
batch was made.

members.name: etag
members.documentation: The batch's ETag.

IngestionBatchCounts.documentation: How many of a batch's items have each outcome and status.

members.name: byOutcome
members.documentation: Items by their planned outcome.

members.name: byStatus
members.documentation: Items by their status after Start.

IngestionBatchFailure.documentation: Why an ingestion batch failed, as a stable code and a message telling the caller what to do.

members.name: code
members.documentation: What went wrong.

members.name: message
members.documentation:
What went wrong and what to do, written for the integrator. The same for every batch with the
same code.

members.name: action
members.documentation: What the item does to its document. Defaults to `ingest`.

members.name: path
members.documentation:
The document's path: its folder and name, for example `/hr/leave-policy.pdf`. A re-upload at a
path is a new version of the document there.

members.name: externalId
members.documentation:
The caller's own key for the document. When given, it identifies the document wherever it is,
so a renamed file keeps its document.

members.name: sha256
members.documentation: For described content: the base64-encoded SHA-256 of the bytes.

members.name: byteSize
members.documentation: For described content: the size of the bytes, at most 2 GB.

members.name: contentType
members.documentation: For described content: the media type of the bytes.

members.name: fetchUrl
members.documentation:
For fetched content: the `http` or `https` address the server fetches the bytes from while
planning, at most 100 MB. Needs the files create permission, which the server checks when the
item is added.

members.name: sourceUrl
members.documentation:
The address a citation of the document links to. Defaults to `fetchUrl` when that is an `https`
address; with an `http` `fetchUrl` and no `sourceUrl`, the document has none.

members.name: metadata
members.documentation:
Values for the metadata fields the knowledge base defines, checked as CreateDocument checks
them, and kept as sent.

members.name: extraMetadata
members.documentation: Keys the knowledge base does not define, within the limits on ExtraMetadata.

members.name: id
members.documentation: The identifier every call about this item takes, within its batch.

members.name: outcome
members.documentation: What the plan found. Absent until the batch is planned.

members.name: reason
members.documentation: For `conflict`: why the plan could not decide. For `fetch_failed`: why the fetch failed.

members.name: metadataChanged
members.documentation: For `unchanged`: true when the supplied metadata or `sourceUrl` differ from the document's.

members.name: matches
members.documentation: The existing documents the outcome refers to. Never a document the caller may not read.

members.name: resolution
members.documentation: What will be done: set by the policy, or by hand with UpdateIngestionBatchItem.

members.name: status
members.documentation: Where the item is. `draft` before Start.

members.name: objectKey
members.documentation:
After Start, for an item awaiting upload: the key to upload its bytes to, under the batch's
upload policy.

members.name: documentId
members.documentation: The document the item made or changed.

members.name: version
members.documentation: The document version the item made or changed.

members.name: failureCode
members.documentation:
Why the item failed, as a stable code: for example `UPLOAD_EXPIRED` (no bytes arrived by the
batch's `uploadsExpireAt`), `CHECKSUM_MISMATCH`, `PERMISSION_DENIED`, for `new_version`
`VALIDATION_FAILED` (another file type) or `DOCUMENT_INGESTION_IN_PROGRESS`, or a document's
failure code. Present only when `status` is `failed`.

members.name: failureDetail
members.documentation: What went wrong, written for the integrator. Present only when `status` is `failed`.

members.name: etag
members.documentation: The item's ETag; send it as `If-Match` to resolve it.

IngestionBoundary.documentation:
The folder a batch is kept inside, so that a batch cannot change documents anywhere else in the
knowledge base.

members.name: folderPath
members.documentation:
Every item must lie inside this folder; any other item is refused. The boundary only refuses
items: it never removes anything.

IngestionHints.documentation: What a client read of a file before uploading it.

members.name: pages
members.documentation: Pages, for a paged document.

members.name: textPages
members.documentation: Pages with a text layer.

members.name: graphicPages
members.documentation: Pages that are mostly graphics.

members.name: scannedPages
members.documentation: Pages with no text layer, read from the image.

members.name: pictures
members.documentation: Pictures to describe.

members.name: mediaSeconds
members.documentation: Seconds of audio or video.

members.name: characters
members.documentation: Characters, for a Markdown or Word document.

IngestionItemInput.documentation: One item a caller adds to a batch.

members.name: action
members.documentation: What the item does to its document. Defaults to `ingest`.

members.name: path
members.documentation:
The document's path: its folder and name, for example `/hr/leave-policy.pdf`. A re-upload at a
path is a new version of the document there.

members.name: externalId
members.documentation:
The caller's own key for the document. When given, it identifies the document wherever it is,
so a renamed file keeps its document.

members.name: sha256
members.documentation: For described content: the base64-encoded SHA-256 of the bytes.

members.name: byteSize
members.documentation: For described content: the size of the bytes, at most 2 GB.

members.name: contentType
members.documentation: For described content: the media type of the bytes.

members.name: fetchUrl
members.documentation:
For fetched content: the `http` or `https` address the server fetches the bytes from while
planning, at most 100 MB. Needs the files create permission, which the server checks when the
item is added.

members.name: sourceUrl
members.documentation:
The address a citation of the document links to. Defaults to `fetchUrl` when that is an `https`
address; with an `http` `fetchUrl` and no `sourceUrl`, the document has none.

members.name: metadata
members.documentation:
Values for the metadata fields the knowledge base defines, checked as CreateDocument checks
them, and kept as sent.

members.name: extraMetadata
members.documentation: Keys the knowledge base does not define, within the limits on ExtraMetadata.

IngestionPolicy.documentation: The rules that resolve each item's outcome. A rule applies to every item not resolved by hand.

members.name: onConflict
members.documentation: What to do with each kind of conflict. Defaults to `{default: "ask"}`.

members.name: onRemove
members.documentation: What to do with a `remove` item that matches a document. Defaults to `remove`.

members.name: onUnchanged
members.documentation:
What to do with an item whose bytes are the current version's. Defaults to `skip`. Supplied
metadata that differs is still updated without ingesting.

members.name: onMoved
members.documentation:
What to do with content found at another path. Defaults to `move`, which keeps the document
and its history.

members.name: widget
members.documentation: The widget the agent asks the person to fill in.

members.name: id
members.documentation: The event's identifier: a cursor, sent back as `after` or `Last-Event-ID`.

members.name: type
members.documentation: The event's type, the same as its SSE `event:` name.

members.name: occurredAt
members.documentation: When it happened.

members.name: subject
members.documentation: What the event is about.

members.name: actor
members.documentation: Who caused it. Named only to the owner of the subject; everyone else sees only its type.

members.name: data
members.documentation: The widget, as `input.requested` on the conversation's own stream.

ItemCreateResult.documentation: The result of adding one item.

members.name: index
members.documentation: The item's position in the request, from 0.

members.name: status
members.documentation: Whether the item was added.

members.name: item
members.documentation: The item, when `created`.

members.name: code
members.documentation: Why it failed, as a stable code. Present only when `failed`.

members.name: detail
members.documentation: What went wrong, written for the integrator. Present only when `failed`.

Job.documentation:
Work running on a knowledge base: ingesting documents, filling in fields, reprocessing, layout-aware
search, a folder change or an access change. The building blocks call it an Operation. Each reports
on the knowledge base's watch: ingests and fill-ins through the ingestion progress feed, and
layout-aware search from its own record.

Deleting the thing a job works on stops the job, which ends `cancelled`.

members.name: id
members.documentation: The identifier GetOperation, WatchOperation and CancelOperation take.

members.name: kind
members.documentation: What kind of work it is.

members.name: status
members.documentation: Where the work is.

members.name: target
members.documentation: What the work is on.

members.name: progress
members.documentation: How far the work has got, where it can say.

members.name: percent
members.documentation:
How far the work has got, from 0 to 100, weighted by how long each part takes; never moves
back.

members.name: eta
members.documentation: How long is left, once the work has run long enough to say.

members.name: costSoFar
members.documentation: What the work has cost so far. Present only for callers who may see cost.

members.name: createdAt
members.documentation: When the work was requested.

members.name: startedAt
members.documentation: When the work started.

members.name: updatedAt
members.documentation: When the Operation last changed.

members.name: endedAt
members.documentation: When the work ended. Present once `status` is final.

members.name: createdBy
members.documentation: Who asked for the work.

members.name: error
members.documentation: Why the work failed. Present only when `status` is `failed`.

members.name: partialFailures
members.documentation: Parts of the work that did not complete, at most the first 100. They never fail the whole.

members.name: job
members.documentation: The job as it now is.

JourneyIntroduction.documentation: The introduction on a journey page.

members.name: eyebrow
members.documentation: The small label above the title, such as "Getting started". Used on `start` only.

members.name: title
members.documentation: The title, such as "Welcome. Let's set up Caitlyn for your organisation."

members.name: lead
members.documentation: The paragraph under the title. Required on `start`.

members.name: buttonLabel
members.documentation: The button, such as "Begin set-up" or "Continue in your set-up chat".

JourneyPoster.documentation: The poster on a journey page.

members.name: label
members.documentation: The words on the poster, such as "Onboarding".

members.name: footer
members.documentation: Short lines at the foot of the poster, one per line, at most 6.

JourneySettings.documentation:
The page shown for a stepped workflow: a poster on one side, and an introduction that changes once
some steps are done. Its steps are the phases' `step` settings, numbered in the order their phases
are declared; a step is done when its phases complete, or when its `doneWhen` signal says so.

members.name: poster
members.documentation: The poster beside the introduction. Always present when read.

members.name: start
members.documentation: What a person sees before they start. Always present when read.

members.name: resume
members.documentation: What a person sees once some steps are done or skipped. Always present when read.

JourneyStep.documentation: A phase's step on the journey page.

members.name: id
members.documentation: Groups phases into steps on the journey page. Phases that share one form one step.

members.name: label
members.documentation: What the journey page calls the step, such as "Knowledge base".

members.name: doneWhen
members.documentation:
A named signal that shows the step done outside the chat, such as `workspaceHasCustomTheme`.
Absent: the step is done when its phases complete.

KnowledgeBase.documentation: A knowledge base: documents an agent can search, with their settings.

members.name: id
members.documentation: The identifier every call about this knowledge base takes.

members.name: name
members.documentation: What people see the knowledge base called in the app.

members.name: description
members.documentation: What the knowledge base holds, in words for the people who use it.

members.name: agentDescription
members.documentation:
What the knowledge base holds, in the words an agent reads to decide when to search it. Shown
only to callers who may change the knowledge base.

members.name: status
members.documentation: Where the knowledge base is in its lifecycle.

members.name: documentCounts
members.documentation:
How many documents are processing, and how many failed, counting each document's latest
attempt. Totals for the whole knowledge base, including documents the caller cannot read.

members.name: retrieval
members.documentation: The search settings an agent uses unless its binding says otherwise.

members.name: features
members.documentation: Optional search and viewing features.

members.name: engine
members.documentation:
How the knowledge base reads and searches its documents. Read-only, and shown only to callers
who may change the knowledge base.

members.name: createdAt
members.documentation: When the knowledge base was created.

members.name: updatedAt
members.documentation: When the knowledge base's settings last changed.

members.name: etag
members.documentation: The knowledge base's ETag; send it as `If-Match` to change it.

KnowledgeBaseBinding.documentation: One knowledge base an agent searches, and how hard.

members.name: knowledgeBaseId
members.documentation: The knowledge base searched. The caller must be able to read it.

members.name: description
members.documentation:
What it holds, so the agent knows when to search it, at most 2,000 characters. Absent uses
the knowledge base's own `agentDescription`.

members.name: maxQueries
members.documentation:
The most searches the agent may write for this knowledge base per question, from 1 to 20.
Defaults to 3.

members.name: numberOfResults
members.documentation: How many passages each search retrieves, from 1 to 50. Defaults to 6.

members.name: minimumScore
members.documentation:
The lowest similarity score a passage needs before it is evaluated, from 0 to 1. Defaults to
0.3.

members.name: minimumRelevance
members.documentation:
The lowest relevance an evaluated passage needs to reach the answer, from 0 to 1. Defaults to
0.5.

members.name: transcriptPanel
members.documentation:
Whether an audio or video citation shows its transcript beside the player. Absent follows the
knowledge base.

members.name: evaluation
members.documentation:
How the passages a search finds are judged before they reach the answer. One method per
search.

members.name: knowledgeBase
members.documentation: The knowledge base as it now is.

KnowledgeBaseEngine.documentation: How a knowledge base reads and searches its documents.

members.name: embeddingModel
members.documentation: The model that turns passages into search vectors.

members.name: reads
members.documentation: What the embedding model reads from each passage.

members.name: dimensions
members.documentation: The size of each search vector.

members.name: region
members.documentation: The AWS Region the model runs in, for example `ap-southeast-2`.

members.name: searchType
members.documentation:
How passages are matched to a search. Layout-aware search is turned on with
EnableLayoutAwareSearch.

KnowledgeBaseEvent.documentation: The events on a knowledge base's watch.

members.name: snapshot
members.documentation: How the thing watched stands now. Always the first event on a connection.

members.name: documentProgress
members.documentation: A document's processing moved on.

members.name: documentCreated
members.documentation: A document was added.

members.name: documentUpdated
members.documentation: A document's details, status or current version changed.

members.name: documentDeleted
members.documentation: A document was deleted.

members.name: documentVersionIndexed
members.documentation: A new version of a document became searchable.

members.name: folderCreated
members.documentation: A folder was created.

members.name: folderUpdated
members.documentation: A folder was renamed, moved, or had its readers changed.

members.name: folderDeleted
members.documentation: A folder was deleted.

members.name: jobProgress
members.documentation: A job moved on.

members.name: jobFinished
members.documentation: A job ended: succeeded, succeeded with failures, failed or cancelled.

members.name: knowledgeBaseUpdated
members.documentation: The knowledge base's settings or status changed.

members.name: nearbyPassages
members.documentation: Whether a search also returns the passages next to each one it finds.

members.name: transcripts
members.documentation: Whether audio and video citations show their transcripts.

KnowledgeBaseSnapshot.documentation: The data of `snapshot`: the thing watched, its jobs, and its documents' progress.

members.name: knowledgeBase
members.documentation: The knowledge base, when the whole knowledge base is watched.

members.name: document
members.documentation: The document, when one document is watched.

members.name: folder
members.documentation: The folder, when one folder is watched.

members.name: batch
members.documentation: The batch, when one batch is watched.

members.name: jobs
members.documentation: The jobs running on what is watched, and those that ended in the last hour.

members.name: progress
members.documentation:
The progress of each document being processed, at most the first 1,000; each entry is what a
`document.progress` event carries.

LatestVersion.documentation: The newest version of a document, when it is not the current one.

members.name: number
members.documentation: The version's number.

members.name: status
members.documentation: Where it is in its lifecycle.

members.name: stage
members.documentation: While `processing`, what the server is doing, for display only.

members.name: failure
members.documentation: Why it failed. Present only when `status` is `failed`.

members.name: createdAt
members.documentation: When it was added.

LiveAvatarSettings.documentation:
A live video avatar that speaks for the agent. Its provider's key is referenced by `secretId`,
never copied, so publishing or resetting from an old version cannot bring back an old key.

members.name: provider
members.documentation: Which company's service runs the avatar. Defaults to `heygen`, the only one.

members.name: secretId
members.documentation:
The stored secret holding the provider's key. Exported as a template variable. The secret must
belong to this workspace, and the caller must be allowed to update the agent's integrations,
the permission v2 asks for when it stores the key.

members.name: answerVersion
members.documentation:
The version of this agent that answers for the avatar: `live`, or a saved version's name.
Absent means this version. `live` follows its moving target, so each publish takes effect
without this setting changing; a saved version's name never moves. `draft` is not accepted:
saving a configuration that names it is refused with 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`.

members.name: triggerPhrases
members.documentation:
Phrases that hand the conversation to the answering version when the avatar says one, at
least one.

members.name: avatarId
members.documentation: Which of the provider's avatars appears.

members.name: voiceId
members.documentation: Which of the provider's voices the avatar speaks with.

members.name: contextId
members.documentation: The provider's conversation context.

members.name: language
members.documentation: The language the avatar speaks, as a BCP 47 tag, for example `en-NZ`.

members.name: holdingPhrases
members.documentation: What the avatar says while an answer is being written.

members.name: muteWhileSpeaking
members.documentation:
When true (the default), the microphone is muted whenever the avatar speaks; when false, only
while an answer is being written, so the person can interrupt.

members.name: speechToText
members.documentation: Which service turns what people say into text. Absent uses the platform's.

members.name: inactivityTimeoutMs
members.documentation: Milliseconds of silence before the avatar ends the conversation. 0 never ends it.

members.name: videoAlignment
members.documentation:
Which part of the video stays in view on a narrow screen: `left`, `centre`, `right`, or a whole
percentage from the left edge, such as `40`.

members.name: voiceTuning
members.documentation: Adjustments to the provider's voice.

members.name: pauseAndResume
members.documentation: When set, people can pause the conversation and carry on later.

LiveState.documentation: Which version live points at, and since when.

members.name: version
members.documentation: The version live points at.

members.name: publishedAt
members.documentation: When live was pointed at it.

members.name: publishedBy
members.documentation: Who pointed live at it.

members.name: enabled
members.documentation: Whether answers show images and media from the passages they cite. Defaults to false.

members.name: reservedResults
members.documentation: How many search results are kept for media, from 0 to 10. Defaults to 2.

MemorySettings.documentation: Whether, and how, the agent remembers people between conversations.

members.name: enabled
members.documentation: Whether the agent remembers. Defaults to false.

members.name: memoryStoreId
members.documentation:
The memory store, from `GET /v3/memory-stores`. Required when `enabled`. The caller must be
able to read the store.

members.name: minimumRelevance
members.documentation: The lowest relevance a memory needs to be recalled, from 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.4.

members.name: maxResults
members.documentation: The most memories recalled for one answer, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 10.

members.name: preferences
members.documentation: Whether the agent remembers what people prefer. Defaults to false.

members.name: summaries
members.documentation: Whether the agent remembers summaries of earlier conversations. Defaults to false.

MemoryStoreSummary.documentation: A memory store an agent can remember people in.

members.name: id
members.documentation: The memory store's identifier, as an agent configuration names it.

members.name: name
members.documentation: The memory store's name, as people see it.

members.name: id
members.documentation: The identifier that matches the message across its events and ListMessages.

members.name: role
members.documentation: Who wrote the message.

members.name: text
members.documentation: What the message says. For an answer, the whole text the deltas built up.

members.name: agentVersion
members.documentation: The agent version that wrote an answer.

members.name: citations
members.documentation: The passages an answer cites, in citation number order.

members.name: attachments
members.documentation: The documents the message carries, in the order they were sent.

members.name: createdAt
members.documentation: When the message was written.

members.name: name
members.documentation: The document's name, as it was on the sender's machine.

members.name: contentType
members.documentation: The document's media type.

members.name: byteSize
members.documentation: The document's size in bytes.

members.name: message
members.documentation: The complete answer message.

members.name: id
members.documentation: The event's identifier: a cursor, sent back as `after` or `Last-Event-ID`.

members.name: type
members.documentation: The event's type, the same as its SSE `event:` name.

members.name: occurredAt
members.documentation: When it happened.

members.name: subject
members.documentation: What the event is about.

members.name: actor
members.documentation: Who caused it. Named only to the owner of the subject; everyone else sees only its type.

members.name: data
members.documentation: The answer, as `message.completed` on the conversation's own stream.

MessageFailed.documentation: The data of `message.failed`: a problem details object, exactly as an error response body.

members.name: type
members.documentation:
A stable URI for the code: its page in the public error reference,
`https://build.caitlyn.ai/errors/{code}`.

members.name: title
members.documentation: A short, human-readable summary of the problem, the same for every occurrence of the code.

members.name: status
members.documentation: The HTTP status code, repeated from the response.

members.name: code
members.documentation:
The stable code, for example `NOT_FOUND`. Once shipped a code keeps its meaning and is never
renamed; callers match on it.

members.name: detail
members.documentation:
What went wrong in this occurrence, written for the integrator. Never holds stack traces,
storage keys or another person's data.

members.name: requestId
members.documentation:
The request's identifier, the same value as the `Caitlyn-Request-Id` header. Quote it to
support.

members.name: errors
members.documentation:
Field-level problems, one per member or parameter at fault. Present only on 400
`VALIDATION_FAILED` and on the 422 `METADATA_*` codes.

members.name: id
members.documentation: The event's identifier: a cursor, sent back as `after` or `Last-Event-ID`.

members.name: type
members.documentation: The event's type, the same as its SSE `event:` name.

members.name: occurredAt
members.documentation: When it happened.

members.name: subject
members.documentation: What the event is about.

members.name: actor
members.documentation: Who caused it. Named only to the owner of the subject; everyone else sees only its type.

members.name: data
members.documentation: The problem, as `message.failed` on the conversation's own stream.

members.name: messageId
members.documentation: The answer message's identifier.

members.name: agentVersion
members.documentation: The agent version answering.

members.name: phase
members.documentation: The workflow phase the answer starts in, where the agent has phases.

MetadataChoice.documentation: One choice of a list field.

members.name: key
members.documentation: The stored value.

members.name: value
members.documentation: What people see.

ModelSettings.documentation: One job's model and its settings.

members.name: model
members.documentation: The model, from `GET /v3/models`. Absent uses the job's default.

members.name: temperature
members.documentation:
Sampling temperature, from 0 to 1. Absent uses the model's default. Refused with 400 for a
model that does not accept it (see `acceptsTemperature` in `GET /v3/models`).

members.name: topP
members.documentation: Nucleus sampling, from 0 to 1. Absent uses the model's default.

members.name: topK
members.documentation: Top-K sampling, from 0 to 250. Absent uses the model's default.

members.name: maxOutputTokens
members.documentation: The most tokens the job may write, from 1 to 16,384. Defaults to 2,048.

members.name: maxAttempts
members.documentation: How many times a failed call to the model is tried, from 1 to 10. Defaults to 3.

members.name: reasoning
members.documentation: Native reasoning, for a model that supports it; refused with 400 for one that does not.

ModelSummary.documentation: A model an agent can use, and the settings it accepts.

members.name: id
members.documentation: The model's identifier, as an agent configuration names it.

members.name: name
members.documentation: The model's name, as people see it.

members.name: reasoning
members.documentation:
Whether the model reasons before it answers, and whether an agent's `reasoning` setting can
change that.

members.name: effortLevels
members.documentation: The reasoning effort levels it offers. Empty when it offers none.

members.name: acceptsTemperature
members.documentation: Whether it accepts `temperature`.

members.name: acceptsTopP
members.documentation: Whether it accepts `topP`.

members.name: acceptsTopK
members.documentation: Whether it accepts `topK`.

members.name: maxOutputTokens
members.documentation: The most tokens it can write in one answer.

NearbyPassages.documentation: The passages next to each one a search finds.

members.name: enabled
members.documentation: Whether they are returned. Defaults to false.

members.name: count
members.documentation: How many on each side, from 0 to 2. Defaults to 1.

NumberRange.documentation: A range of numbers, low to high.

members.name: low
members.documentation: The low end.

members.name: high
members.documentation: The high end.

Operation.documentation:
Background work that continues after the request that started it: a job, as the building blocks
see it. Read it, wait on it or watch it; never start the work again to find out how it went. An
Operation is kept for at least 7 days after it ends.

members.name: id
members.documentation: The identifier GetOperation, WatchOperation and CancelOperation take.

members.name: kind
members.documentation: What kind of work it is.

members.name: status
members.documentation: Where the work is.

members.name: target
members.documentation: What the work is on.

members.name: progress
members.documentation: How far the work has got, where it can say.

members.name: percent
members.documentation:
How far the work has got, from 0 to 100, weighted by how long each part takes; never moves
back.

members.name: eta
members.documentation: How long is left, once the work has run long enough to say.

members.name: costSoFar
members.documentation: What the work has cost so far. Present only for callers who may see cost.

members.name: createdAt
members.documentation: When the work was requested.

members.name: startedAt
members.documentation: When the work started.

members.name: updatedAt
members.documentation: When the Operation last changed.

members.name: endedAt
members.documentation: When the work ended. Present once `status` is final.

members.name: createdBy
members.documentation: Who asked for the work.

members.name: error
members.documentation: Why the work failed. Present only when `status` is `failed`.

members.name: partialFailures
members.documentation: Parts of the work that did not complete, at most the first 100. They never fail the whole.

OperationError.documentation: Why an Operation failed: a problem with a stable code.

members.name: code
members.documentation: What went wrong, as a stable code.

members.name: detail
members.documentation: What went wrong and what to do, written for the integrator.

OperationEvent.documentation: The events on an Operation's stream.

members.name: operationUpdated
members.documentation: The Operation changed.

members.name: operationFinished
members.documentation: The Operation is final. The stream ends after it.

members.name: operation
members.documentation: The Operation as it ended.

OperationProgress.documentation: How far an Operation's work has got.

members.name: completed
members.documentation: Units of work done.

members.name: total
members.documentation: Units of work in all, when known.

members.name: failed
members.documentation: Units of work that failed.

members.name: unit
members.documentation: What `completed`, `failed` and `total` count.

OperationTarget.documentation: What an Operation's work is on.

members.name: type
members.documentation: What kind of thing `id` names.

members.name: id
members.documentation: The thing's identifier.

members.name: knowledgeBaseId
members.documentation: The knowledge base it is in, for a document or folder.

members.name: operation
members.documentation: The Operation as it now is.

OrganisationSummary.documentation: The identifier and name of an organisation.

members.name: id
members.documentation: The identifier calls about the organisation take.

members.name: name
members.documentation: What people see the organisation called.

PartialFailure.documentation: An enrichment that did not complete. It never fails the document.

members.name: targetId
members.documentation: The part of the document the enrichment was for, where there is one.

members.name: code
members.documentation: What went wrong, as a stable code.

members.name: detail
members.documentation: What went wrong, written for the integrator.

PauseAndResume.documentation: Pausing a live avatar conversation and carrying on later.

members.name: openingIntro
members.documentation: What the avatar says when a conversation starts fresh, at most 1,000 characters.

members.name: resumeIntro
members.documentation:
What the avatar says in place of the intro when a paused conversation resumes, at most 500
characters.

members.name: pausedTimeoutMs
members.documentation:
Milliseconds a paused conversation stays resumable, from 60,000 to 3,600,000. Defaults to ten
minutes.

Phase.documentation:
One phase of a workflow. `kind` decides which kind-specific members apply; a member that does not
apply to the kind is refused with 400, never ignored.

members.name: id
members.documentation: The phase's identifier, unique within the workflow.

members.name: kind
members.documentation: What the phase does, which decides which of its other members apply.

members.name: instructions
members.documentation: The phase's own instructions, added to the agent's while it runs.

members.name: tools
members.documentation: The tools the phase may use, at most 30.

members.name: transitions
members.documentation: Where the conversation may go from this phase.

members.name: maxSteps
members.documentation:
The most model calls the phase may make in one answer, from 1 to 50. Defaults to 10, or 30
for `policy_review`.

members.name: reasoning
members.documentation: Native reasoning while the phase runs.

members.name: opening
members.documentation: What the person sees when a conversation starts in, or enters, this phase.

members.name: step
members.documentation: This phase's step on the journey page, when it is part of one.

members.name: onEnd
members.documentation: What happens when the phase ends the conversation. Absent means the conversation carries on.

members.name: unattended
members.documentation:
When true, the phase runs with no person: it asks the person nothing, and must finish with its
own tools. Defaults to false. For `gather_info`, `take_action` and `policy_review`.

members.name: repliesOnEntry
members.documentation:
For `conversational`: when true, the phase replies as soon as an earlier phase hands over,
rather than waiting for the person. Defaults to false.

members.name: toolCallChecks
members.documentation: Checks each tool call against a rule before it runs.

members.name: attributionChecks
members.documentation: Checks that each answer's claims are supported by what it cites.

members.name: fields
members.documentation: For `gather_info` and `take_action`: what the phase asks for or needs.

members.name: next
members.documentation:
For `gather_info`, `take_action` and `policy_review`: the phase to move to when this one is
done.

members.name: handover
members.documentation:
For `gather_info`, `take_action` and `policy_review`: how this phase wraps up before it hands
over to `next`.

members.name: outcomeDescription
members.documentation:
For `gather_info`, `take_action` and `policy_review`: what the phase's outcome is, and how
later phases should use it.

members.name: responses
members.documentation: Set replies the phase may give, each chosen by its description.

members.name: action
members.documentation: For `take_action`: the action the phase takes.

members.name: policyRules
members.documentation:
For `take_action`: the policy rules this phase checks, as `<policyId>/<ruleId>`. Each policy
must be in `policies`. The caller must be able to read each policy, checked on every save as
for `policies`; one it cannot read is refused with 404 `NOT_FOUND`.

members.name: review
members.documentation: For `policy_review`: the policy the phase reviews against, and which of its rules.

members.name: description
members.documentation: What the action is, in plain words.

members.name: requiredTools
members.documentation:
Tools the agent must call, at least one of them, before the action counts as done. Empty means
the agent's own account of what it did is enough.

members.name: completesOnRequiredTool
members.documentation: When true, the phase completes as soon as one of `requiredTools` succeeds. Defaults to false.

members.name: phase
members.documentation: The phase the agent is now in.

members.name: previousPhase
members.documentation: The phase it left.

PhaseEnd.documentation: What happens when a phase ends the conversation.

members.name: type
members.documentation: What happens to the conversation when the phase ends it.

members.name: restartIn
members.documentation:
For `restart`: the phase the next message starts in. Defaults to the conversation's entry
phase.

members.name: closingMessage
members.documentation: For `close`: what the person is told.

PhaseField.documentation: One thing a phase asks for or needs: a field to gather, or an earlier phase that must be done.

members.name: id
members.documentation: The field's identifier, unique within the phase.

members.name: kind
members.documentation:
Whether the entry is a value the phase gathers or an earlier phase that must be done first.
Defaults to `field`.

members.name: description
members.documentation: For `field`: what the value is. Required on a field.

members.name: request
members.documentation: For `field`: how the agent asks for it. Required on a field.

members.name: optional
members.documentation: For `field`: when true, the phase may finish without it. Defaults to false.

members.name: type
members.documentation: For a `field`: what kind of value it holds. Defaults to `text`.

members.name: acceptedTypes
members.documentation: For a `document` field: the file extensions accepted, for example `pdf`.

members.name: maxByteSize
members.documentation: For a `document` field: the largest file accepted, in bytes.

members.name: documentField
members.documentation: For a `document` field: the document metadata field the value fills.

members.name: sources
members.documentation: For `field`: where the value may come from, in order. Absent means the person.

members.name: prerequisite
members.documentation: For `prerequisite`: the phase that must be done first. Required on a prerequisite.

PhaseOpening.documentation: What the person sees when a conversation starts in, or enters, a phase.

members.name: message
members.documentation:
A message shown before the person types anything. `@user:firstName`, `@user:lastName` and
`@user:email` are replaced with the person's details.

members.name: input
members.documentation: A form, buttons or choices shown with the message, as `input.requested` carries one.

members.name: onEveryEntry
members.documentation:
When true, the opening is shown whenever the conversation enters the phase, not only when a
conversation starts in it. Defaults to false.

PhaseResponse.documentation: A set reply a phase may give, chosen by its description.

members.name: id
members.documentation: The reply's identifier, unique within the phase.

members.name: description
members.documentation: When the agent gives this reply.

members.name: request
members.documentation: What the agent says.

PhaseTool.documentation: A tool a phase may use: one of Caitlyn's own, or the tools on an MCP server.

members.name: name
members.documentation: One of Caitlyn's own tools, from `GET /v3/tools`. Exactly one of `name` and `mcpServerId`.

members.name: mcpServerId
members.documentation:
An MCP server whose tools the phase may use. Exactly one of `name` and `mcpServerId`. With no
`tools`, every tool on the server, including tools it adds later; otherwise only those
listed. Exported as a template variable. The caller must be able to read the server.

members.name: tools
members.documentation: With `mcpServerId`: only these of the server's tools.

members.name: excludedTools
members.documentation: With `mcpServerId` and no `tools`: the server's tools the phase may not use.

members.name: description
members.documentation: What the tool is for, in the agent's words. Absent uses the tool's own description.

members.name: enabled
members.documentation: Whether the phase may use the tool. Defaults to true.

members.name: use
members.documentation: How the agent uses what the tool returns. Defaults to `default`.

members.name: citationLabel
members.documentation: What a citation of this tool's results is called, for example "Policy register".

members.name: search
members.documentation: For Caitlyn's knowledge base search tool: how it searches.

PhaseTransition.documentation: A way out of a phase.

members.name: to
members.documentation: The phase it leads to.

members.name: condition
members.documentation: The condition, in plain words, that makes this the way out. The agent decides by it.

members.name: kind
members.documentation: How the way out is gated. Defaults to `alternative`.

members.name: skipLabel
members.documentation:
For `skip`: the words on the chat's skip button, such as "Skip theme configuration". Required
on a skip.

members.name: requiresUserChoice
members.documentation:
When true, the agent may take this way out only on the person's express choice. Defaults to
false.

members.name: when
members.documentation: Takes this way out automatically when a value matches, without the agent deciding.

members.name: handover
members.documentation: How this phase wraps up before it hands over through this way out.

members.name: startedIn
members.documentation: Only when the conversation started in one of these phases.

members.name: notStartedIn
members.documentation: Never when the conversation started in one of these phases.

PolicyBinding.documentation: One policy an agent version uses.

members.name: policyId
members.documentation:
Which policy the version may review documents against.
The caller must be able to read the policy. This is checked for every policy id sent, not only
new ones, because the rules go into the cached prompt. A policy the caller cannot read is
refused with 404 `NOT_FOUND`.

PolicyReviewSettings.documentation: The policy a `policy_review` phase reviews against.

members.name: policyId
members.documentation:
Which policy the phase reviews against. It must be in `policies`.
The caller must be able to read the policy. This is checked for every policy id sent, not only
new ones, because the rules go into the cached prompt. A policy the caller cannot read is
refused with 404 `NOT_FOUND`.

members.name: ruleIds
members.documentation:
The rules to check. Absent means every rule in the policy, read again each time a review
starts.

members.name: reviewStageId
members.documentation: The policy's review stage this phase reviews at. Absent for a policy with no review stages.

ProcessingEstimate.documentation: What the work on a document was expected to take and cost.

members.name: durationSeconds
members.documentation: How long it was expected to take, in seconds.

members.name: cost
members.documentation: What it was expected to cost. Absent for callers who may not see cost.

members.name: refined
members.documentation: True once refined from what ingestion measured of this document.

members.name: id
members.documentation: The step's identifier, unique within the message.

members.name: label
members.documentation: What the step is doing, for display.

members.name: details
members.documentation: More detail for display.

members.name: status
members.documentation: The step's status. Absent means running.

members.name: section
members.documentation: The section of the answer the step belongs to, for display.

Readers.documentation: Who may read a folder's or a document's contents.

members.name: kind
members.documentation: How the readers are decided. With `specific`, `roles` and `people` say who.

members.name: roles
members.documentation: For `specific`: the roles that may read it.

members.name: people
members.documentation: For `specific`: the people who may read it.

ReasoningSettings.documentation: Native reasoning ("extended thinking") for a model that supports it.

members.name: enabled
members.documentation:
Whether the model reasons before it answers. Defaults to false; a model whose `reasoning` is
`always` reasons whatever this says.

members.name: effort
members.documentation:
How much effort the model spends reasoning. Absent uses the model's default. Refused with 400
for a level the model does not list in `effortLevels`.

ResultEvaluation.documentation: How the passages a search finds are judged.

members.name: method
members.documentation: What judges the search results. Defaults to `reranker`.

members.name: maxSearchResults
members.documentation: The most passages each search keeps for evaluation, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 10.

members.name: maxResults
members.documentation:
The most passages kept after evaluation, from 1 to 100, and at most `maxQueries` ×
`maxSearchResults`. Defaults to 10.

members.name: judge
members.documentation:
For `model`: the model that judges each passage. Unset members fall back to
`models.planning`.

members.name: reranker
members.documentation:
For `reranker`: the reranking model, from `GET /v3/models`. Absent uses the platform's
preference.

RetrievalDefaults.documentation: A knowledge base's default search settings.

members.name: resultsPerSearch
members.documentation: How many passages each search retrieves, from 1 to 50.

members.name: minimumMatch
members.documentation: The lowest similarity score a passage needs, from 0 to 1.

members.name: minimumRelevance
members.documentation: The lowest relevance an evaluated passage needs, from 0 to 1.

RoleAccess.documentation: What one role may do with a knowledge base.

members.name: roleId
members.documentation: The role this grant is for.

members.name: name
members.documentation: The role's name, as people see it. Returned; ignored when sent.

members.name: can
members.documentation: What the role may do with the knowledge base.

RunAs.documentation: Whose permissions an unattended run of this version uses.

members.name: roleId
members.documentation:
The role whose permissions unattended runs use. The caller may name only a role it could
assign.

StreamReset.documentation: `stream.reset`: where the stream carries on from. Its SSE `id` is the same cursor.

members.name: cursor
members.documentation: The new cursor. Send it back as `Last-Event-ID` on a reconnect.

members.name: delta
members.documentation: The next fragment of answer text, to append to what came before.

members.name: model
members.documentation: The model, from `GET /v3/models`. Absent uses a small, fast model.

members.name: maxOutputTokens
members.documentation: The most tokens a title may take, from 1 to 512. Defaults to 32.

members.name: maxAttempts
members.documentation: How many times a failed call to the model is tried, from 1 to 10. Defaults to 2.

ToolCallChecks.documentation: Checks each tool call against a rule before it runs.

members.name: policy
members.documentation: The rule, in plain words, every tool call is checked against.

members.name: model
members.documentation: The model that checks. Absent uses `models.planning`.

members.name: maxRetries
members.documentation: How many times a refused call may be corrected, from 0 to 10. Defaults to 2.

members.name: toolCallId
members.documentation: Matches the tool call's finish to its start.

members.name: toolName
members.documentation: The tool called.

members.name: status
members.documentation: How the call ended.

members.name: result
members.documentation: The call's result. Present only when the caller may read it.

members.name: durationMs
members.documentation: How long the call took, in milliseconds.

members.name: id
members.documentation: The event's identifier: a cursor, sent back as `after` or `Last-Event-ID`.

members.name: type
members.documentation: The event's type, the same as its SSE `event:` name.

members.name: occurredAt
members.documentation: When it happened.

members.name: subject
members.documentation: What the event is about.

members.name: actor
members.documentation: Who caused it. Named only to the owner of the subject; everyone else sees only its type.

members.name: data
members.documentation: The tool call, as `tool.finished` on the conversation's own stream.

ToolSearchSettings.documentation: How Caitlyn's knowledge base search tool searches.

members.name: modes
members.documentation: The search modes the agent may choose from, at least one.

members.name: version
members.documentation:
The version of this agent whose knowledge bases and search settings the tool uses: `live`, or
a saved version's name. `live` follows its moving target, so each publish takes effect without
this setting changing; a saved version's name never moves. `draft` is not accepted: saving a
configuration that names it is refused with 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`.

members.name: toolCallId
members.documentation: Matches the tool call's start to its finish.

members.name: toolName
members.documentation: The tool called.

members.name: arguments
members.documentation: The call's arguments. Present only when the caller may read them.

members.name: name
members.documentation: The tool's name, as a phase names it.

members.name: description
members.documentation: What the tool does, in the words the agent reads unless a phase gives its own.

TranscriptSettings.documentation: Transcripts of audio and video documents.

members.name: enabled
members.documentation: Whether a citation shows the transcript beside the player. Defaults to true.

TransitionMatch.documentation: A value that takes a way out of a phase automatically.

members.name: source
members.documentation: Where the value is read from. Defaults to `tool_result`.

members.name: field
members.documentation:
For `tool_result`, a dotted path into the tool's output, for example `isCovered`; for
`saved_field`, a field of this phase.

members.name: equals
members.documentation:
The value the field must hold: a string, number or boolean. A saved field is compared as a
string.

Upload.documentation: A short-lived slot for the bytes of one file.

members.name: id
members.documentation:
The identifier the operation that uses the upload takes, for example CreateDocument's
`uploadId`.

members.name: status
members.documentation: Where the upload is in its lifecycle.

members.name: expiresAt
members.documentation: When the upload URL stops working.

UploadCompletionResult.documentation: The result of reporting one item's upload.

members.name: itemId
members.documentation: The item the result is for.

members.name: status
members.documentation: Whether the upload was accepted for ingestion.

members.name: code
members.documentation: Why it failed, as a stable code. Present only when `failed`.

members.name: detail
members.documentation: What went wrong, written for the integrator. Present only when `failed`.

UploadDescription.documentation: A file described for an estimate, before it is uploaded.

members.name: name
members.documentation: The name the file will be uploaded with.

members.name: contentType
members.documentation: The file's media type.

members.name: byteSize
members.documentation: The file's size in bytes.

members.name: hints
members.documentation: What the SDK could read of the file cheaply, which makes the estimate closer.

UploadPolicy.documentation:
An upload policy: one signature that lets the caller upload every item of a batch that needs
bytes, each as an HTML form POST.

members.name: uploadUrl
members.documentation: Where to POST each file.

members.name: formFields
members.documentation:
The form fields every upload sends first, in this order, before its own `key`,
`Content-Type`, `x-amz-checksum-algorithm` (`SHA256`), `x-amz-checksum-sha256` and the file.

members.name: keyPrefix
members.documentation: The prefix every item's `objectKey` starts with.

members.name: maxByteSize
members.documentation: The largest file the policy accepts, in bytes.

members.name: expiresAt
members.documentation:
When the policy stops working, the batch's `uploadWindowSeconds` after it was issued. Renew it
with CreateIngestionBatchUploadPolicy.

UploadPurpose.documentation: What an upload is for. At most one member is set.

members.name: agentAvatar
members.documentation:
True when the file is an agent's avatar picture: a PNG, JPEG or WebP image of at most 1 MB,
checked when the upload is reserved. Use the upload as `avatar.mark.pictureUploadId` on
CreateAgent or UpdateAgent.

members.name: conversationId
members.documentation:
The conversation the file will be attached to. The caller must be able to send to it (its
update grant, as SendMessage needs); otherwise the call is refused with 404, as for a
conversation it may not see. Its agent's attachment settings (whether it takes attachments, how
many, how large and which types) are checked before the upload is reserved, and a file they
refuse is refused with 400 `ATTACHMENTS_NOT_ACCEPTED` or `VALIDATION_FAILED`.

VoiceSettings.documentation: Whether, and how, the agent speaks its answers.

members.name: provider
members.documentation:
What speaks the agent's answers. Defaults to `browser`. The voices on offer are listed by
`GET /v3/voices`.

members.name: voiceId
members.documentation: For `cloud`: the voice, from `GET /v3/voices`, for example `Aria`.

members.name: quality
members.documentation: For a cloud voice: how natural it sounds. Defaults to `natural`.

members.name: language
members.documentation: The language and accent, as a BCP 47 tag, for example `en-NZ`. Defaults to `en-NZ`.

VoiceSummary.documentation: A cloud voice an agent can speak in.

members.name: id
members.documentation: The voice's identifier, as an agent configuration names it.

members.name: name
members.documentation: The voice's name, as people see it.

members.name: language
members.documentation: The language and accent it speaks, as a BCP 47 tag, for example `en-NZ`.

members.name: qualities
members.documentation: The qualities it comes in.

WorkspaceEvent.documentation:
The events on the workspace stream, each named by its SSE `event:` line, which equals the
event's `type`. Clients skip event names they do not know.

members.name: conversationCreated
members.documentation: A conversation was started.

members.name: messageCompleted
members.documentation: An answer was completed.

members.name: messageFailed
members.documentation: An answer failed.

members.name: toolFinished
members.documentation: A tool call in an answer finished.

members.name: inputRequested
members.documentation: The agent asked the person for input through a widget.

members.name: streamReset
members.documentation:
The stream cannot carry on from the cursor it was given: it is more than a day old, or
catching up from it would pass the catch-up limit. The events between are never sent; read
what you need again with the List and Get operations, then carry on from the new cursor.
